Additional information

Army Instructor Competencies, for the pre-observation counseling
  • Domain 1, Foundations of adult teaching and learning. AIC 1 fundamentals of adult learning; AIC 2 model Army leadership in the learning environment.
  • Domain 2, Lesson preparation and design. AIC 3 prepare strategies and methods that promote critical and creative thinking; AIC 4 review learning-level alignment with objectives.
  • Domain 3, Instructional delivery and strategies. AIC 5 effective communication; AIC 6 learner motivation; AIC 7 effective instruction; AIC 8 technology to enhance learning; AIC 9 transfer of learning.
  • Domain 4, Classroom management. AIC 10 set learning-environment conditions; AIC 11 professional relationships, rapport, and trust.
  • Domain 5, Feedback, assessment, and course evaluation. AIC 12 formal and informal feedback; AIC 13 formative and summative assessment; AIC 14 evaluations.

Appendix B of TR 600-21 (Final Draft, interim implementation under TASKORD 3G9B). Each rubric item lists the AICs it observes.

What the visitor folder must contain
  • Visitor sign-in log
  • Class roster (ATRRS R2 report, SSNs removed)
  • Current training schedule
  • Course POI or course management plan, and the current lesson plan
  • Instructor credentials: certification certificate or Commandant's MFR, operator's permit if needed, instructor biography
  • A copy of TF 600-21-1
  • Feedback or observation forms for visitors

The course runs one DD Form 2977 common to all lessons. For the risk assessment check, confirm it is signed by the approval authority and that the block 13 review is current, not just that a copy exists.

Final scores

SectionPointsPercentage

Minimum scores: 80 for Basic Army Instructor, 85 for Senior, 90 for Master (TR 600-21 paras 3-4d(7), 3-4e(8), 3-4f(6), Final Draft in effect under TASKORD 3G9B since 27 June 2025). A single Unacceptable in any item overrides the total and produces a no-go.

I

Administrative data

TF 600-21-4, Instructor Developmental Observation Worksheet (Mar 2025). Not an assessment: the observer records what they learned watching another instructor, then discusses it with that instructor and their supervisor. Basic needs four of these, Senior three (TR 600-21 paras 3-4d(8), 3-4e(9), appendix F).

II

Developmental observations

Discuss each answer in detail; the form does not allow yes or no. Write in the first person. These are your reflections, not a rating of the other instructor.

III

Signatures

Signature blocks stay live on the exported form for the instructor observed, you, and the supervisor. The reg expects a discussion between all three (appendix F).

Records

Every observation, worksheet, and hours sheet saved in the tool, across all instructors. A 2657-R record is created each time you fill the form from the Hours tab; it remembers which entries were on that sheet. Mark each form as it gets signed; an unsigned form is the most common reason a packet comes back.

Instructors

Academic instructor hours

Mirrors USAACE (DOTD) Form 2657-R. Only primary-instructor hours count: hours the lesson plan allocates to a single lead instructor responsible for the learning objective (TR 600-21 para 3-4b). Basic needs 80 after certification; Senior and Master each need 200 more, counted from the day after the previous packet was submitted (para 3-4c). When team teaching, only the hours taught alone as primary instructor count (para 3-4a). Time is entered in hours and minutes, the way the lesson plan carries it, and written to the 2657-R as h:mm. Date every entry; undated hours cannot be placed in a window.

Local settings, for whatever DOTD or the FDRP manager tells you

These change how entries display and export from now on; the stored minutes and lesson codes stay the same, so switching back is harmless. Change them only when someone with the local regulation tells you which is right.

Log from the training schedule

Each row is one lesson on one training day, from every class schedule loaded, with the instructional time the schedule allocates it. Tick the days you taught as primary instructor, in whichever class, and add them in one pass. Days already logged for this instructor are hidden.
